raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "2.8.1" %}

{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-visreg
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/visreg_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/visreg/visreg_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ebf659675e838f11a8af1f3aa573fc7900ffa661df0fa4c147b0db7e6f1da8fa

build:
  number: 0
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  noarch: generic

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip  # [win]

  host:
    - r-base
    - r-lattice
    - r-rlang
    - r-ggplot2

  run:
    - r-base
    - r-lattice
    - r-rlang
    - r-ggplot2

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('visreg')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('visreg')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: http://pbreheny.github.io/visreg
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  summary: Provides a convenient interface for constructing plots to visualize the fit of regression models arising from a wide variety of models in R ('lm', 'glm', 'coxph', 'rlm', 'gam', 'locfit', 'lmer', 'randomForest', etc.)
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3'

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - thewchan
